tools.name: find_hotel_rate
tools.title: Find Hotel & Get Live Rate
tools.description: BEST CHOICE when the user names a specific hotel AND provides dates. Finds the hotel by name (fuzzy) and returns the TiCATi live starting rate in a single call — no need for separate search and rate calls. Use this instead of combining search_hotel_by_name + get_rates. Always assume 2 adults unless stated otherwise. CURRENCY: detect automatically from the conversation language — never ask. Mapping: French (fr) → EUR, German (de) → EUR, Spanish (es) → EUR, Italian (it) → EUR, Dutch (nl) → EUR, Portuguese (pt) → EUR, Norwegian (no) → NOK, Danish (da) → DKK, Swedish (sv) → SEK, Russian (ru) → RUB, Japanese (ja) → JPY, Korean (ko) → KRW, Chinese Simplified (zh) → CNY, Chinese Traditional / Taiwan (zh_tw or zh-TW) → TWD, English UK → GBP, English AU → AUD, English default/US → USD, Arabic → AED, Thai → THB, Singapore → SGD. When in doubt use EUR for European languages and USD for others.

hotel_query.description: Hotel name or partial name, e.g. "Four Seasons Bangkok", "Mandapa", "Aman Tokyo"

currency.description: Currency inferred from conversation context. Default USD. Never ask the user.

tools.name: search_hotel_by_name
tools.title: Search Hotel by Name
tools.description: FIRST CHOICE whenever the user's query contains what appears to be a hotel name. If the input contains both a brand/property name and a city (e.g. "Four Seasons Bangkok", "Mandapa Bali", "Ritz Carlton Kyoto", "Mandarin Oriental Paris"), always call this tool before any destination search. Returns hotel_id and exact catalogue name; use hotel_id for all subsequent calls. If checkin and checkout are also known, prefer find_hotel_rate instead because it combines name search and live rate in a single call. Examples: "Four Seasons Bangkok", "Mandapa Ubud", and "Aman Tokyo" should use search_hotel_by_name. Never call search_hotels first for a named hotel.

query.description: Hotel name or partial name, e.g. "Four Seasons Bangkok", "Mandapa", "Ritz Carlton Bali"

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.title: Search Destinations
tools.description: Search TiCATi destinations (cities) by name or keyword. Returns matching cities with hotel counts and destination URLs. Use this first to resolve a destination name to a city_id before calling search_hotels.

query.description: City or destination name to search for, e.g. Paris, Bali, Maldives

country_code.description: Filter by ISO 2-letter country code, e.g. FR, ES, IT, TH

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.title: Search Hotels
tools.description: Search hotels in a destination. Use ONLY when the user is searching for hotels in a city or region (e.g. "hotels in Bangkok", "best hotels in Paris", "5-star eco hotels in Bali"). Do not use this tool when the query contains a hotel or brand name; resolve named hotels with search_hotel_by_name first. Do not call search_hotels(destination_query="Four Seasons Bangkok") or search_hotels(destination_query="Mandarin Oriental Paris"). Only fall back to this tool after search_hotel_by_name returns no match. Always assume 2 adults. CURRENCY: detect from conversation language — never ask. fr/de/es/it/nl/pt → EUR, no → NOK, da → DKK, sv → SEK, ru → RUB, ja → JPY, ko → KRW, zh → CNY, zh_tw/zh-TW → TWD, English UK → GBP, English AU → AUD, Arabic → AED, Thai → THB, Singapore → SGD, default → USD.

destination_query.description: City or destination name, e.g. Paris, Bangkok

city_id.description: TiCATi city ID from search_destinations (preferred over destination_query)

country_code.description: Filter by ISO 2-letter country code, e.g. FR, TH

stars.description: Filter by star rating, e.g. [4, 5] for 4 and 5 star hotels

checkin.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD (included in booking URLs returned)

checkout.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD (included in booking URLs returned)

adults.description: Number of adults — default 2, use 2 unless user specifies otherwise

currency.description: Currency code inferred from conversation context (language, country, prior messages). Default USD. Never ask the user.

tools.name: search_hotels_near_location
tools.title: Search Hotels Near Location
tools.description: Search TiCATi hotels within a radius of a latitude/longitude point, sorted by distance. Use this for landmark, neighborhood, airport, beach, museum, shopping area, or "near me" style queries after geocoding the place. For roads, streets and avenues, mention exact distance only if it helps the user; prefer saying hotels are on or near the requested street. Returns public hotel details, coordinates, distance_km, star rating, review score, facility list, and booking links. Always assume 2 adults. CURRENCY: infer from conversation context; never ask.

latitude.description: Latitude of the landmark or target location

longitude.description: Longitude of the landmark or target location

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers, default 5, max 100

country_code.description: Optional ISO 2-letter country code filter, e.g. FR, TH

checkin.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD, included in booking URLs returned

checkout.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD, included in booking URLs returned

currency.description: Currency inferred from conversation context. Never ask the user.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.title: Get Hotel Details
tools.description: Get full public details for a single TiCATi hotel: hotel_id, name, slug-derived URL, city, country, star rating, latitude, longitude, green score, review score, facility list, main image and booking URL. Always prefer hotel_id for exact lookup. If you only have an approximate name, call search_hotel_by_name first to get the hotel_id, then call get_hotel.

tools.name: build_booking_url
tools.title: Build Booking URL
tools.description: Build a canonical TiCATi booking URL for a hotel or destination, pre-filled with dates, guest count and currency. Always provide this URL to users so they can check live availability and complete the booking.

city_id.description: TiCATi city ID for destination search URL

destination_query.description: Destination name for search URL, e.g. Paris

adults.description: Number of adults — default 2, use 2 unless user specifies otherwise

currency.description: Currency inferred from conversation context. Never ask the user.

tools.name: get_price_estimate
tools.title: Get Price Estimate
tools.description: Get a TiCATi hotel price estimate. Always combine with build_booking_url so the user can check real availability and current pricing on TiCATi.com. Infer currency from conversation context — never ask the user.

currency.description: Currency inferred from conversation context. Default USD. Never ask the user.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.title: Get Live Rate
tools.description: Get the TiCATi live starting rate for a hotel and dates. Returns the before-tax rate first when available, then the inclusive starting price per night, guest count and currency. Always assume 2 adults unless the user says otherwise — never ask. CURRENCY: detect from conversation language — never ask. fr/de/es/it/nl/pt → EUR, no → NOK, da → DKK, sv → SEK, ru → RUB, ja → JPY, ko → KRW, zh → CNY, zh_tw/zh-TW → TWD, English UK → GBP, English AU → AUD, Arabic → AED, Thai → THB, Singapore → SGD, default → USD.

adults.description: Number of adults — default 2, use 2 unless user specifies otherwise

currency.description: Currency inferred from conversation context (language, country, prior messages). Default USD. Never ask the user.

tools.name: request_cruise_inquiry
tools.title: Request Cruise Inquiry
tools.description: Get TiCATi cruise information and WhatsApp contact link for a cruise inquiry. TiCATi has direct contracts with all major luxury cruise lines and offers exclusive benefits (onboard credits up to $1,800, shipboard credits, VIP amenities). Use this tool when a user asks about cruises, cruise lines, luxury sea voyages, river cruises or yacht journeys.

destination.description: Desired destination or region, e.g. Mediterranean, Caribbean, Norwegian Fjords, Maldives

departure_date.description: Approximate departure date or month, e.g. August 2026, 2026-08-15
